definitions.explanation: A female child or young teenager, typically referring to girls roughly between ages 7 and 17.

examples.japanese: {少女|しょうじょ}たちが{公園|こうえん}で{遊|あそ}んでいる。
examples.english: The girls are playing in the park.

examples.japanese: {少女|しょうじょ}{漫画|まんが}は{女性|じょせい}に{人気|にんき}がある。
examples.english: Shojo manga is popular with women.
examples.notes: 少女漫画 refers to manga targeted at young female readers

examples.japanese: {彼女|かのじょ}は{少女|しょうじょ}のころから{ピアノ|ぴあの}を{習|なら}っていた。
examples.english: She has been learning piano since she was a young girl.

notes:
{少女|しょうじょ} is the female counterpart of {少年|しょうねん} (boy).

AGE RANGES:
- {少女|しょうじょ}: roughly 7-17 years old
- {女|おんな}の{子|こ}: girl (general, any age)
- {女児|じょじ}: female child (formal/official)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {少女|しょうじょ}{時代|じだい} (girlhood)
- {少女|しょうじょ}{漫画|まんが} (shojo manga)
- {美|び}{少女|しょうじょ} (beautiful girl)
